Now let me understand the expected test changes. The tests currently expect:
- `test/validate/pass_jsonl_empty_verbose.sh`: `warning: The JSONL file is empty`
- `test/validate/pass_jsonl_empty.sh` presumably expects nothing? Let me look.

The task says the tests that cover this change are `pass_jsonl_empty` tests, which run the CLI against an empty JSONL file and compare stderr.

Currently `LOG_VERBOSE(options) << "warning: The JSONL file is empty\n";` — so this warning only prints with --verbose. With the new helper, it must ALWAYS write to std::cerr regardless of --verbose. So the non-verbose test `pass_jsonl_empty.sh` now needs to expect the warning too. Let me look at those tests.
